acquisition_channels.details: Ron said early work came through word of mouth and contractor recommendations.
He researched contractors, called them, and tried to set meetings.
He emailed contractor prospects; he said calling worked better.
He drove to meet prospects, shook hands and introduced himself.
He used Thumbtack for paid electrical leads.

ideas.delivery: Ron performs site walks and electrical work himself, and can subcontract larger projects to 1099 crews. He handles customer communication, invoicing and quality oversight.

prices: upwards of $1,000 per week on Thumbtack

uk_legal_risk.reason: The business used cold email to contractor prospects without specifying their legal form or an opt-out. In the UK, cold email should be limited to corporate subscribers such as limited companies, with an opt-out; do not email sole traders or individuals without consent.

ideas.other_uk_rules: For UK outreach, apply UK GDPR to prospect data and screen cold calls against TPS/CTPS. UK electrical work also needs to meet applicable UK competence and building requirements.
